title: Uncut edit operations
description: Every change to project.json, by the user or the agent, is a list of these ops. They are applied atomically, recorded in history.db with who made them, and are what the agent sees in the manual-edit log.

oneOf.description: Add an item. On the main track give an index (default: the end); on free tracks the item needs a start.

Change fields on an item. A null value removes the field; nested objects (transform, style, animation) and arrays (keys, gainKeys) are replaced whole. A clip's box (D75): transform {x, y, w, h (canvas pixels), fit contain|cover|fill, scale (zoom inside the box), opacity 0-1, radius}; keys [{frame, ease?, x?, y?, scale?, opacity?}] animate x, y, scale and opacity (frames from the item's start; ease linear|in|out|inOut shapes the motion to the next key); loop true repeats the media when the clip is longer. Text style (D80): preset (a text-style look; fields left out use the look's), size, weight, font, color, align, tracking, lineHeight, uppercase, stroke {width, color}, shadow {x, y, blur, color, opacity}, background {color, opacity, padding, radius, wrap box|lines} in canvas px; false for stroke, shadow or background removes the look's. Text animation (D81): in/out {module, duration, params}: move.word-by-word {style pop|fade|rise}, move.zoom {scale, ease, fade}.
Shorten (positive) or lengthen (negative) an item from one edge. Trimming the start moves its in-point; on the main track the rest ripples.
Split an item at a frame counted from the item's start. The second half gets newId.
Move an item in time or to another track. Main track: index. Free tracks: start.
Remove an item. On the main track the rest closes the gap.

Set or clear (null) the transition into a main-track item (not the first). Drawn modules: transition.crossfade (2–60 frames), transition.dip-to-black (4–90 frames, needs no media handles), transition.wipe (4–30 frames, revealed from the left), transition.iris (6–30 frames, a circle opening from the centre), transition.push-left (4–30 frames, the next item pushes this one out to the left), transition.zoom (4–30 frames, the outgoing picture zooms in 20 % as the next fades in). Both items must be at least twice the duration; every one but dip to black needs ceil(duration/2) frames of video before the incoming clip's in-point and after the outgoing clip's out-point. transition.cut draws as a crossfade.

module.description: A transition module id: transition.crossfade, transition.dip-to-black, transition.wipe, transition.iris, transition.push-left or transition.zoom.

duration.description: Length in frames, centred on the cut.

oneOf.description: Change project-level fields: name, canvas, theme, scenes, markers or master.
